output.reason: [ev-bacdc0376810] says only that Argo CD switches its default logging to JSON. A default that changes but keeps working is behavior-change, so the class is review. The proposed text says the old default was 'text' and names a --log-format flag and an ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT env var, none of which appear in the evidence, so the correction removes them.

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 switches its default logging to JSON. Environments that rely on the default log format get JSON logs and keep running; the change needs review, not mandatory action.

consequence.statement: Argo CD's default log output becomes JSON. Components keep running, but log parsing, monitoring or alerting that expects the old default format may stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Check that log collection, parsing and alerting handle JSON logs. If you need a different format, configure the log format explicitly using the setting documented upstream.
